recipes.name: Goodles + Chicken Sausage
ing: 1 box Goodles (split across both nights — half a box each)
4 chicken sausage links, sliced into coins
Milk and butter as the box calls for

steps.t: Sausage coins into a dry skillet over medium-high. They are already cooked — you are only browning the cut faces, about 4 minutes total, one flip.
Make the Goodles exactly per the box while the sausage browns.
Tip the sausage and any browned bits into the finished mac and stir once.

recipes.note: Brown the sausage, do not just heat it. The cut faces going dark is where all the flavor comes from, and it costs four minutes in a pan you were not otherwise using. Half a box plus two links is one dinner; the box covers both nights.

recipes.name: Turkey Taco Bowl
ing: Half a bell pepper + half an onion, diced
1 packet taco seasoning · 1 microwave rice pouch
Salsa, shredded cheese, Greek yogurt, lime

steps.t: Medium-high, splash of oil. Pepper and onion, 4 min.
Turkey in. Break it up, cook until no pink, ~7 min.
Taco seasoning plus a splash of water. Simmer 2 min until it clings.
Rice pouch in the microwave. Build the bowl: rice, turkey, then salsa, cheese, yogurt, and a squeeze of lime.

recipes.note: The yogurt is doing sour cream’s job. Same texture, a few grams of protein instead of none.

recipes.name: Meatballs & Marinara
ing: 6 frozen turkey meatballs (8 if you want it closer to 55g)
Half a jar of marinara · 1 microwave rice pouch

steps.t: Meatballs and marinara into a saucepan from frozen, lid on, medium heat. 8 min, stirring once.
Rice pouch in the microwave near the end.
Rice down, meatballs and sauce over, cheese on top to melt in the heat.

recipes.note: The laziest meal here by some distance. Two things from the freezer and pantry into one pan, no knife, no board. Meatball brands vary a lot on protein — check the bag and bump the count if yours runs low.
